Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.dst: Ve onunla karşılaşır- Işığın Canavarı Orphion ile.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.speaker:
Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.src: Let's go {u}, they meet up above the bank.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.dst: Hadi gidelim {u}, bankanın üst katında toplanıyorlar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.speaker: Olon

similar.text: Let's go . They meet up above the bank.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.src: Try looking around the graves a bit? Maybe they can give us some information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.dst: Mezarların etrafına biraz bakmaya ne dersin? Belki bize bilgi verirler.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.src: You make your way out of the cemetery...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.src: Alright- this meeting is over with, glad we got to an agreement.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.dst: Pekâlâ- toplantı bitti, anlaşmaya varabildiğimize sevindim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.speaker: Elder Oak

similar.text: Alright. This meeting is now over. Glad we got to an agreement.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#092.src: Ehm- I know this is impolite of me, which is exactly why I'm doing it!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#092.dst: Ehm- bunun kabalık olduğunu biliyorum, zaten tam da bu yüzden yapıyorum!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#092.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#095.src: I know who you are, {u}. Do you know who I am?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#095.dst: Kim olduğunu biliyorum, {u}. Peki sen benim kim olduğumu biliyor musun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#095.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.src: Enough playing around, I need your assistance. You see... There is something fishy going on behind these doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.dst: Bu kadar oyun yeter, yardımına ihtiyacım var. Bak... Bu kapıların ardında bir şeyler dönüyor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#097.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die", well it's true, or so at least I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.dst: "Elfler asla ölmez" diye bir söz duydun mu hiç? Doğru, ya da en azından öyle sanıyordum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#098.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#102.src: I've always heard since I was young that Elves cannot die from old age. Well... recently, my parents both died.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#102.dst: Küçüklüğümden beri elflerin yaşlılıktan ölemeyeceğini duyarım. Şey... yakın zamanda annemle babam öldü.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#102.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.src: Could you try asking around, see if anyone knows about this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.dst: Etrafa sorabilir misin, bakalım bu konuda bir şey bilen var mı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#106.src: I will wait up here. Return to me if you find out any valuable information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#106.dst: Ben burada bekleyeceğim. İşe yarar bir bilgi bulursan yanıma dön.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#106.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#107.src: Check with the elves around {p} Town for information.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.src: Welcome to {p} Town. Home of the elves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#115.src: I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#115.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.src: But why are you telling me that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.src: Your attitude is really starting to annoy me, young traveler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.dst: Tavrın beni gerçekten sinirlendirmeye başladı, genç gezgin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#121.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.src: I don't care if you have defeated all the monsters in the world, never ask a woman like me of her age.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.dst: Dünyadaki bütün canavarları yenmiş olsan da umurumda değil, benim gibi bir hanımefendiye asla yaşını sorma.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#122.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.src: You seem like such a kind adventurer, you humans aren't all so bad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.dst: Ne kadar nazik bir maceracısın, siz insanlar o kadar da kötü değilmişsiniz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.src: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.src: I don't really see how that is connected to {p} though.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.dst: Ama bunun {p} ile ne ilgisi var, pek anlamadım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#135.src: You never ask a woman her age. Did you not know that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#135.dst: Bir hanımefendiye asla yaşı sorulmaz. Bunu bilmiyor muydun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#135.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#136.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#136.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.dst: Merak etme, yolunu bulman için yüce Amber burada!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.dst: Adım Amber, Sol Elçiliği Kraliyet Görev Gücü'nden!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#144.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#144.dst: SEN HIRSIZ DEĞİLSİN, DEĞİL Mİ? YA DA SOYGUNCU? YA DA KATİL!? KUNDAKÇI!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#144.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.dst: Hayal gücüm yine beni ele geçirdi!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.dst: Asıl işim etrafta devriye gezmek ve kimsenin yapmaması gereken bir şey yapmadığından emin olmak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#149.src: Maybe I shouldn't have said all of that...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#149.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.dst: Başka bir konuda yardımcı olabilir miyim?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what. Who buys what. Who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.dst: Kasabaya kimin gelip gittiğini rapor ederim. Kim ne satıyor. Kim ne alıyor. Kim kiminle konuşuyor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#153.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#153.dst: Liste uzayıp gidiyor da gidiyor da gidiyor... da gidiyor... da gidiyor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#153.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#154.src: They like keeping track of what happens inside the town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#154.dst: Kasabada olan biteni takip etmeyi severler!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#154.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#156.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#156.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#160.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#160.dst: Bu harika kasabanın tadını çıkar. Yardım istemekten çekinme!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#160.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#171.src: I... I... No! Bullies don't affect me... *sniffles*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#171.dst: Ben... ben... Hayır! Zorbalar beni etkilemez... *burnunu çeker*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#171.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#174.src: Oh it's you. I can't believe we let a human into this place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#174.dst: Ah, sen misin. Buraya bir insanı aldığımıza inanamıyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#174.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.dst: Benimle böyle konuşmaya nasıl cüret edersin?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.dst: Yapacağım son şey olsa bile seni sınır dışı ettireceğim, sözlerimi unutma!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#180.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#180.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.dst: Sormamda sakınca yoksa... Arkadaşın {p} bölgesinden mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.src: Farewell. Make sure to let everyone know I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.dst: Elveda. Herkese en akıllının ben olduğumu söylemeyi unutma!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#202.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#202.dst: Siz insanlar gerçekten aptalsınız, söylemem lazım... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#202.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.dst: Buradakilerin çoğundan gencim, anlarsın. Daha yüz yaşındayım sayılır.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#209.src: No. Do you not know of the child regulations here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#209.dst: Hayır. Buradaki çocuk kurallarını bilmiyor musun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#209.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.src: There are very strict restrictions on who or when someone can have children here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.dst: Burada kimin, ne zaman çocuk sahibi olabileceğine dair çok sıkı kısıtlamalar var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.dst: Elflerin {p} bölgesine taşınmasının asıl sebebi, aile kurmak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.dst: Pek söyleyemem... Burada kuralları çiğnemek hiç istemezsin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#216.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#216.dst: Sana biraz bilgi verebilirim ama sonra beni rahat bırakacaksın.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#216.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#225.src: I'm not that much for... image and status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#225.dst: Ben pek... imaj ve statü meraklısı değilimdir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#225.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#228.src: Return to Olon with the information at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#228.dst: Bilgilerle birlikte [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Olon'un yanına dön.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#235.src: Good idea! I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#235.dst: İyi fikir! Bazı elflerin kasabanın altından geçen bir yeraltı nehrinden bahsettiğine kulak misafiri oldum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#235.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#236.src: So if you find water, you find the river.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#236.dst: Yani suyu bulursan nehri de bulursun.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#236.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#237.src: I'll keep my distance, don't want to draw too much attention.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#237.dst: Ben mesafemi koruyacağım, fazla dikkat çekmek istemiyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#237.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#239.src: I don't know how that will solve anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#239.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.src: I mean, you talked to the citizens so maybe you know something I don't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.dst: Yani halkla sen konuştun, belki benim bilmediğim bir şey biliyorsundur.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.src: Sure. Let's meet up at the potion merchant then.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.dst: Olur. O zaman iksir tüccarının yanında buluşalım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.src: Amber here! Ready to catch the bad guys!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.dst: Amber burada! Kötü adamları yakalamaya hazırım!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#244.src: Are you here to report something?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#244.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.src: Hold on! Why are you with an {p} elf? Is this some sort of spy mission to take over {p} and turn it into a capitalistic society?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.dst: Dur bakalım! Neden bir {p} elfiyle birliktesin? Bu, {p} şehrini ele geçirip kapitalist bir topluma çevirmek için bir casusluk görevi falan mı?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#246.src: I will have to report this to the elders immediately!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#246.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#248.src: I am a respected member of the task force. My only friend is the law.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#248.dst: Ben görev gücünün saygın bir üyesiyim. Tek dostum kanundur.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#248.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.src: I'm not sure what the punishment for talking to an {p} elf is but I would imagine at least hanging and dawn. Or is there even a punishment?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.dst: Bir {p} elfiyle konuşmanın cezası ne bilmiyorum ama en azından şafakta asılmaktır herhalde. Yoksa cezası bile yok mu?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#251.src: Let's just get out of here. I saw looking into the underground river would have been the smartest move in the first place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#251.dst: Hadi buradan gidelim artık. Baştan beri en akıllıca hamlenin yeraltı nehrine bakmak olduğunu söylemiştim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#251.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#253.src: But money... I could go shopping in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#253.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#256.src: Alright time to listen to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#256.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#258.src: Find the underground area of {p} near the waterfall.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#258.dst: Şelalenin yakınında {p} kasabasının yeraltı bölgesini bul.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#259.src: Let's hope no elves are following us down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#259.dst: Umarım aşağıya bizi takip eden bir elf yoktur.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#259.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#263.src: Let's look for objects that resemble the {p} style down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#263.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#264.src: So yeah, let's hope we didn't draw any unneeded attention by doing all that unnecessary stuff.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#264.dst: Yani evet, umarım o gereksiz işlerle boşuna dikkat çekmemişizdir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#264.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.src: What exactly are we doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.src: Why didn't you just say that. Here, it's on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.dst: Bunu baştan söyleseydin ya. Al, benden.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.src: Can we get back on track now?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.src: I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town. So if you find water, you find the river.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.dst: Bazı elflerin kasabanın altından geçen bir yeraltı nehrinden bahsettiğine kulak misafiri oldum. Yani suyu bulursan nehri de bulursun.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#284.src: This looks suspicious enough to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#284.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.src: Let me see if I can get us through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#289.src: Cast a spell on the boulders with Olon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#289.dst: Olon ile birlikte kayalara büyü yap.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.src: Did you just... dig up a grave?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.dst: Sen az önce... bir mezar mı kazdın?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.src: This is an important piece of HISTORY.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.src: I will look away and pretend I didn't see that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.dst: Başımı çevirip hiçbir şey görmemiş gibi yapacağım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.src: Investigate the graves in the tomb.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)He will welcome you with open arms, your devotion to knowledge was unmatched.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (Geçit Öncesi)Seni kollarını açarak karşılayacak, bilgiye bağlılığın eşsizdi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.speaker: Natt Moonchaser

Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)To reunite with her lost sister. May the light bring her this gift for her devotion.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (Geçit Öncesi)Kayıp kız kardeşine kavuşmak için. Işık bu bağlılığına karşılık ona bu armağanı versin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.speaker: Dew Riverbreeze

Aldorei's Secret Part II#303.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)Will forever be remembered for his poetry and texts. May you be reunited with the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#303.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (Geçit Öncesi)Şiirleri ve yazılarıyla sonsuza dek hatırlanacak. Işığa yeniden kavuşasın.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#303.speaker: Moln Cloudcatcher

Aldorei's Secret Part II#304.src: I assume you found the same stuff I did.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#304.dst: Sanırım sen de benim bulduklarımı buldun.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#304.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#307.src: {~} years ago... Could this be connected to the portal over in the Wynn province?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#307.dst: {~} yıl önce... Bunun Wynn eyaletindeki geçitle bir bağlantısı olabilir mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#307.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.src: Did the elves of {p} actually grasp the light?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.src: And meet him. The God of Light, Orphion.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.dst: Ve onunla buluşmak. Işık Tanrısı Orphion ile.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.src: I think it's time we pay the elders a visit.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.dst: Bence ihtiyarları ziyaret etme vakti geldi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#317.src: They have some explaining to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#317.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.src: It's sad to say, but it's true.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.src: People who are knowledgable, magically gifted or well versed in the arts are seen as better.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.dst: Bilgili, büyüye yetenekli ya da sanatlarda usta olanlar daha üstün görülür.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.src: I would assume the majority got the lesser ones...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.dst: Sanırım çoğunluğa daha sade olanlar düştü...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.src: I'll make sure {p} NEVER becomes like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: They should be at the top of this building. Follow the golden carpet to get there!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: Bu binanın en üst katında olmalılar. Oraya gitmek için altın halıyı takip et!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.src: We need to watch out for the guards.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: This is our chance to run past!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: Yanlarından koşup geçmek için fırsat bu!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: We know your dark secrets and we have proof!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.dst: Karanlık sırlarınızı biliyoruz ve kanıtımız var!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.src: What nonsense, who let this ginger rat in here!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.dst: Ne saçmalık, bu kızıl sıçanı buraya kim soktu!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.src: Who are you calling a rat!? Pulling the ginger card too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.dst: Sen kime sıçan diyorsun!? Bir de kızıllığımı yüzüme vuruyorsun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.src: Can somebody please get the Sol Embassy Guards for us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.dst: Biri bizim için Sol Elçiliği Muhafızlarını çağırabilir mi lütfen?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: Wait a second... human, what are you doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: Bir saniye... insan, senin burada ne işin var?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: We saw you arrive with this elf, us elders aren't that gullible.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.dst: Bu elfle birlikte geldiğini gördük, biz ihtiyarlar o kadar saf değiliz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.src: ... I really thought you'd have my back out there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.src: What are you REALLY doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: So you admit that your invitation to {p} is being used to threaten us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.dst: Demek {p} davetinin bizi tehdit etmek için kullanıldığını kabul ediyorsun.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#371.src: I knew letting foreigners into our town would come back to bite us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#371.dst: Yabancıları kasabamıza almanın başımıza iş açacağını biliyordum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#371.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#372.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#372.dst: Muhafızlar- bu baş belalarını tutuklayın ve zindanlara atın!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#372.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: And you admit you're a part of this elf's posse?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.dst: Ve bu elfin çetesinden olduğunu da kabul ediyorsun, öyle mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.dst: Muhafızlar- bu baş belalarını tutuklayın ve zindanlara atın.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: You said you had proof of something, tell me- what have you found?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.dst: Bir şeyin kanıtı olduğunu söyledin, söyle bakalım- ne buldunuz?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.src: We found the old cemetery under the city and aren't afraid to expose you to the world!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.dst: Şehrin altındaki eski mezarlığı bulduk ve sizi bütün dünyaya ifşa etmekten korkmuyoruz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: My parents both suffered and I only have you to blame for it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: Annemle babam acı çekti ve bunun için suçlayabileceğim tek kişi sizsiniz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: That's enough! To the dungeons with you now!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: I'm sure you must realize by now we are the elders for a reason?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: Artık bizim boşuna ihtiyar olmadığımızı anlamışsındır herhalde?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: Us elves are ten times more powerful than any human by nature.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.dst: Biz elfler doğamız gereği herhangi bir insandan on kat daha güçlüyüz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.src: Just because we tend to solve things peacefully doesn't mean we can't use brute force.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.dst: Sorunları barışçıl yollarla çözmeyi tercih etmemiz kaba kuvvet kullanamayacağımız anlamına gelmez.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: No! {u}, I am not letting this go! I will get justice for my parents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: Hayır! {u}, bunun peşini bırakmıyorum! Annemle babamın hakkını alacağım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: Pfft- it's merely a design flaw.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.dst: Pöh- bu sadece bir tasarım kusuru.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#394.src: Don't try to trick us with your mind games.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#394.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#409.src: Escape the town hall with Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.src: You know... I didn't really think that would work, and I was right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.dst: Biliyor musun... bunun işe yarayacağını pek sanmıyordum ve haklıymışım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.src: But I think I figured it out...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: Exactly! You've got a keen eye for this kinda thing.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.dst: Aynen! Bu tür şeylere keskin bir gözün var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.src: The question is if she lied, or if something else happened.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.dst: Soru şu: yalan mı söyledi, yoksa başka bir şey mi oldu?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.src: One of the seats were empty but most importantly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.dst: Koltuklardan biri boştu ama asıl önemlisi...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.dst: Arkalarındaki raflara göz attım ve başka bir isimle imzalanmış kâğıtlar gördüm.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: Yani soru şu... onlara ne oldu?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.src: No- but I noticed something that didn't add up with our previous information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.dst: Hayır- ama önceki bilgilerimizle uyuşmayan bir şey fark ettim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.src: One of the seats were empty and one of the elves mentioned six elders, did she not?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.dst: Koltuklardan biri boştu ve elflerden biri altı ihtiyardan bahsetmişti, değil mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: I'm guessing the Elders got into a big disagreement and decided to rid of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: Tahminimce İhtiyarlar büyük bir anlaşmazlığa düştü ve ondan kurtulmaya karar verdi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: So I doubt they have any records of that occuring here...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.dst: Yani burada bunun kaydını tuttuklarını pek sanmıyorum...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#427.src: Our best bet is to find somebody that may have seen what happened here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#427.dst: En iyi şansımız burada olanları görmüş olabilecek birini bulmak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#427.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.src: Y'know I'm pretty good friends with the {p} Scouts.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.dst: Biliyor musun, {p} İzcileriyle aram epey iyidir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.src: They are really observant of everything that goes on in and around the canyons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.dst: Kanyonların içinde ve çevresinde olan her şeyi çok dikkatle gözlerler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.src: Meet me outside the {p} {p}, speak with me if you'd like to travel there together.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.dst: Benimle {p} {p} önünde buluş, oraya birlikte gitmek istersen benimle konuş.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#431.src: Meet up with Olon outside the {p} in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.src: Let's go then! Glad you want to travel with me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.dst: Hadi o zaman! Benimle yolculuk etmek istemene sevindim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.src: Here we are! The capital of Gavel, home of a lot of things I'm sure.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.dst: İşte geldik! Gavel'in başkenti, eminim pek çok şeye ev sahipliği yapıyordur.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.src: Alright- so we have to come up with a plan on what to do next, I have a few suggestions myself.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.dst: Pekâlâ- sırada ne yapacağımıza dair bir plan yapmamız lazım, benim de birkaç önerim var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.src: I've done some work for the {p} staff in the past and happen to know a few of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.dst: Geçmişte {p} çalışanları için bazı işler yaptım, birkaçını tanıyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.src: We are actually quite good friends, what do you think?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.dst: Aslında epey iyi arkadaşız, ne dersin?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#437.src: Sounds like a good plan to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#437.dst: Bana iyi bir plan gibi geliyor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#437.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.src: Head inside and look for someone who doesn't seem busy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.dst: İçeri gir ve meşgul görünmeyen birini ara.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.src: So you want us to sneak in?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.dst: Yani gizlice içeri girmemizi mi istiyorsun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.src: Do you even know where we need to go?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.dst: Nereye gitmemiz gerektiğini biliyor musun ki?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.src: Thought so... good thing I'm here then!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.dst: Ben de öyle düşünmüştüm... iyi ki buradayım o zaman!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.dst: Daha önce de söylediğim gibi, içerideki bahçelerin bakımına yardım ediyordum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.dst: Orada burada birkaç şey öğrendim, tabii ki! Vardığım sonuç şu...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.dst: Lonca binasının en üstünde eski askeri belgelerin saklandığı bir oda var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.dst: Artık pek kullanılmıyor, yani yukarı çıkmak kolay olmayacak... benimle köprünün altında buluş.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.dst: Seni görmeyeli çok uzun zaman oldu! İyiyim, ailem de iyi!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.dst: Sevindim! Dinle- bugün epey meşgulüz, eski askeri belgelerin nerede tutulduğunu biliyor musun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.dst: Şu kurduğun teoriyle mi ilgili? Aslında- yakın zamanda orada biraz iş yaptım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.dst: Yanımdaki merdivenlerden çıkınca bir asansör var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.dst: Lütfen sonra gelip konuş! Sohbetlerimizi özledim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.dst: Harika! Hemen o asansörle yukarı çıkalım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda köprünün altında Olon ile buluş.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.src: The archive should be at the top of one of the big towers of the {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.dst: Arşiv, {p} binasının büyük kulelerinden birinin tepesinde olmalı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.src: I had a brilliant idea of blessing you with some of my magic that you can hopefully use to get in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.dst: Seni biraz büyümle kutsamak gibi parlak bir fikrim var, umarım içeri girmek için kullanabilirsin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.dst: Eski arkadaşımla buluşmaya gitmek istiyorum, umarım yakında görüşürüz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.dst: Yanımızdaki beyaz büyü havuzunu görüyor musun?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.dst: Arşive doğru yola çıkmak için [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki büyü havuzunu kullan.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Hokkabaz tüccarı kullanarak ya da [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumuna yürüyerek {p} kasabasına dön

Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.dst: Buldun mu? Harika, tam düşündüğüm gibi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.dst: Pekâlâ- plan şu. Ben geride kalıp bahsedilen yerin haritasını arayacağım, raporları neredeyse her zaman düzgünce işaretlerler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.dst: Benimle {p} kasabasının doğu çıkışında buluş. Şimdilik ihtiyarlardan uzak durmaya çalışalım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.dst: {p} kasabasına dönmek istersen, {p} içinde seni oraya bedavaya götüren "hokkabaz" denen bir tüccar olduğunu duydum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.dst: Bu yol {p} bölgesine çıkıyor, o yüzden bir süre etrafa bakmamız gerekebilir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.dst: Kanyon kendi kendine hareket ediyor. Pekâlâ, gidelim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.dst: Sizi durdurmaya gelmedim. Aslında yardım etmek istedim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.dst: Bu kasabada, bu toplumda yanlış olan çok şey var. Verdiğimiz hükümler...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.dst: Biz elfler kusursuz değiliz. Öyle demeyi severiz- ve açıkçası çoğumuz buna inanır da.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.dst: {p} içinde hep değişimin öncüsü olmak istedim ama çarpık yollarına saplanıp kalmışları ikna etmek zor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.dst: Lütfen, İhtiyar Birch'ü geri getirin- benim için. Mantarlı bir mağaraya rastlayana dek sağdaki dağ yolunu takip edin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.dst: Bu arada benim de İhtiyarlara soracaklarım var- ikinize de bol şans.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.src: Find your way through the canyon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.dst: Burada ne yaptığınızı ve kim olduğunuzu açıklamak için bir dakikanız var, yoksa dağları başınıza yıkarım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.dst: Bir elf ve bir insan- evimin içinde!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.dst: ONLARA söyleyebilirsiniz, sürgün edildiğimden beri evimden çıkmadım. Tek kelime etmedim, bir şey yapmayı aklımdan bile geçirmedim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.dst: İhtiyarlarla birlikte değiliz. Ben {p} bölgesindenim! Gerçek için buradayız.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.dst: Demek bu bir sınav, öyle mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.dst: Yoksa... beni... geri mi istiyorlar? Bu yüzden mi buradasınız?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.dst: İhtiyarlarla hiçbir bağlantımız yok! Kişisel sebeplerle buradayım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#503.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#503.dst: Kanıtla! Beni bu kadar çabuk unutacaklarına inanamıyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#503.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.dst: Ee ne olmuş? Bu hiçbir şey kanıtlamaz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#508.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#508.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.dst: Elbette öyle demiştir, hep benim tarafımı tuttu.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.dst: Ama size hiçbir şey anlatmayacağım. Sadece Alder için geliyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#513.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#513.dst: Alder asla böyle bir şey söylemez... hele senin gibilere hiç.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#513.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.dst: Kusura bakma- bunun beni İhtiyarlarla olmadığınıza nasıl ikna edeceğini bilmiyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#517.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#517.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.dst: Sizi İhtiyarlar gönderdiyse cevabı zaten biliyor olmalısınız.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#519.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#519.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#522.src: Are you two a bit slow or what? We are not killing anyone!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#522.dst: Siz ikiniz biraz kalın kafalı mısınız nesiniz? Biz kimseyi öldürmüyoruz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#522.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.src: If anything, the {p} elves brought it upon themselves by leaving our city.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.dst: Olsa olsa {p} elfleri şehrimizi terk ederek bunu kendi başlarına getirdi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.src: Let's just say the town is magical. That's all you need to know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.dst: Diyelim ki kasaba büyülü. Bilmen gereken bu kadar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.src: Really... it seems I can't escape the past.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.dst: Gerçekten de... görünüşe göre geçmişten kaçamıyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.src: I don't know what it is... but I want you to tell me more...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.dst: Ne olduğunu bilmiyorum... ama bana daha fazlasını anlatmanı istiyorum...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#529.src: Maybe it's time- time to confront the elders again. We must go.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#529.dst: Belki de vakti geldi- ihtiyarlarla yeniden yüzleşme vakti. Gitmeliyiz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#529.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.src: Of course things happened- things happen everywhere!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.dst: Elbette bir şeyler oldu- her yerde bir şeyler olur!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#533.src: Elves are magical, that's why the city is magical.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#533.dst: Elfler büyülüdür, şehir de bu yüzden büyülü.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#533.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.src: I'm not going to tell you anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.src: {p} doesn't care about {p} elves, why would they kill them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.dst: {p} halkı {p} elflerini umursamaz bile, neden onları öldürsünler?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.src: Well, why are you here then?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.src: If you are so close, what do you need me for?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.dst: Bu kadar yakınsanız bana ne ihtiyacınız var?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.src: Even though I have been banished, I would never want something like that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.dst: Sürgün edilmiş olsam da asla böyle bir şey istemem.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.src: Go on ahead. This is not something I expected to happen...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.dst: Siz önden gidin. Böyle bir şey olacağını beklemiyordum...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.src: Return to the Elders with Elder Birch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.dst: İhtiyar Birch ile birlikte [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki İhtiyarların yanına dön.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.src: You've got guts coming back here after everyth-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.dst: Onca şeyden sonra buraya dönmeye yüzün var ha-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.src: Actually- we have someone that you might be interested in meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.dst: Aslında- tanışmak isteyebileceğiniz biri var yanımızda.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.src: What is the meaning of this?!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.src: It's been so long, I didn't think you would come back.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.dst: Çok uzun zaman oldu, geri döneceğini düşünmemiştim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.src: Alder- I am sorry but the only reason I have returned is to set things right once and for all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.dst: Alder- üzgünüm ama dönmemin tek sebebi her şeyi bir kez ve tamamen düzeltmek.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.src: These two individuals have the right to know what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.dst: Bu ikisinin neler olup bittiğini bilmeye hakkı var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.src: Are you out of your MIND! We voted on this all those years ago!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.dst: AKLINI mı kaçırdın! Bunu yıllar önce oylamıştık!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.src: If you tell them ANYTHING about the tree I will make sure your eternal life ends right here and now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.dst: Onlara ağaç hakkında TEK KELİME edersen sonsuz hayatının burada ve şimdi sona ermesini sağlarım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.src: Oak- that is ENOUGH! Can't you see- this human is fighting the war we begun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.dst: Oak- bu kadar YETER! Görmüyor musun- bu insan bizim başlattığımız savaşı veriyor!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#556.src: They've earned it- they should know. Salvation of our light, our redemption!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#556.dst: Bunu hak ettiler- bilmeleri gerek. Işığımızın kurtuluşu, bizim kefaretimiz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#556.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.src: I agree with Elder Birch, sir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.src: {u}, Olon- the war you are fighting...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#560.src: We- we are the ones to blame. Our kind, our people...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#560.dst: Biz- suçlu olan biziz. Soyumuz, halkımız...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#560.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.src: The elves are the reason the world is in calamity. All because of one, senseless, selfish mistake.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.dst: Dünyanın felakete sürüklenmesinin sebebi elfler. Hepsi tek bir anlamsız, bencil hata yüzünden.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.src: The worst fate that this world has seen, a fate beyond comprehension.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.dst: Bu dünyanın gördüğü en kötü kader, akıl almaz bir kader.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.src: Your leading question, about our immortality. The answer is simple- but there is more to it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.dst: Asıl sorunuz ölümsüzlüğümüzle ilgiliydi. Cevap basit- ama dahası var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.src: We... we revealed the first gate- giving way for the darkness...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.dst: Biz... ilk kapıyı biz açığa çıkardık- karanlığa yol açarak...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.src: I'd rather if we show you. Meet me under the Cherry Blossom tree.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.dst: Size göstermeyi tercih ederim. Benimle Kiraz Çiçeği ağacının altında buluşun.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#567.src: I- I will join you as well.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#567.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.src: Head down to the Cherry Blossom tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.src: This place- here is where it all began.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.src: The center of the Elven society, under the tree that protects our civilization.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.dst: Elf toplumunun merkezi, uygarlığımızı koruyan ağacın altı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.src: And, brings upon us our immortality...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.src: The roots expand deep inside this cavern that we've used for storage over the years.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.dst: Kökleri, yıllardır depo olarak kullandığımız bu mağaranın derinlerine uzanıyor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.src: At least two Elders are required to open the passage. We will open the way for you two now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.dst: Geçidi açmak için en az iki İhtiyar gerekiyor. Şimdi ikiniz için yolu açacağız.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.src: Be careful, nobody was meant to return there so certain defense mechanisms were put in place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.dst: Dikkatli olun, oraya kimsenin dönmemesi gerekiyordu, bu yüzden bazı savunma düzenekleri kuruldu.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.src: Also, the information you will learn can harm all elves, unfortunately some things must be kept a secret.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.dst: Ayrıca öğreneceğiniz bilgiler bütün elflere zarar verebilir, ne yazık ki bazı şeyler sır olarak kalmalı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.src: I've had a very bad feeling that we won't like what we see...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.dst: Gördüklerimizden hoşlanmayacağımıza dair çok kötü bir his var içimde...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.src: Well... It's too late to back down now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.dst: Neyse... Artık geri dönmek için çok geç.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#583.src: Do you feel the magical energy, it's almost like I can touch it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#583.dst: Büyü enerjisini hissediyor musun, sanki dokunabilirmişim gibi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#583.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.src: Is the water filled with logs?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.src: Have you noticed this... plant in the middle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.dst: Ortadaki şu... bitkiyi fark ettin mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.src: It seems like this place is so alive, I mean just look at all of this coming from the logs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.dst: Burası öyle canlı ki, kütüklerden çıkan şu şeylere bir bak!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.src: If you are here to stop us, we won't hesitate to hurt you!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.dst: Bizi durdurmaya geldiyseniz size zarar vermekten çekinmeyiz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.src: On the contrary. I... realize, that this is something we can no longer keep quiet about.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.dst: Tam tersine. Bunun artık susamayacağımız bir şey olduğunu... anladım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.src: When you brought back Birch... it brought back memories, and I must admit. It made me realize I had lost myself along the way.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.dst: Birch'ü geri getirdiğinizde... anılar da geri geldi ve itiraf etmeliyim ki yol boyunca kendimi kaybettiğimi fark ettim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.src: We were ashamed of our actions- all of us. Scared for our people. If they knew the truth... there would be riots, wars, innocents would die!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.dst: Yaptıklarımızdan utanıyorduk- hepimiz. Halkımız için korktuk. Gerçeği bilselerdi... isyanlar, savaşlar çıkar, masumlar ölürdü!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.src: But because we locked up {p} from the outside, we grew a... god complex, so to speak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.dst: Ama {p} şehrini dış dünyaya kapattığımız için bir tür... tanrılık kompleksine kapıldık.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.src: We lost track of why we locked ourselves in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.src: You will find the answers to your questions once you lay grasp of the wood.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.src: I assume you two already noticed the intense magical energy coming from here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.dst: Sanırım ikiniz de buradan yayılan yoğun büyü enerjisini fark ettiniz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#595.src: This is the source of our immortality.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#595.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.src: The remnants of the original Guardian of the Forest.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#598.dst: Olon ile birlikte kütüğün içine gir.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.src: I have summoned you two for an important meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.dst: İkinizi önemli bir toplantı için çağırdım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.src: What did you see this time?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.src: It was unclear... The only thing I'm certain of is that he contacted me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.dst: Belirsizdi... Emin olduğum tek şey, onun benimle iletişime geçtiği.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#603.src: I think... I think he wants us to witness him. This is finally our chance to grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#603.dst: Sanırım... sanırım onu görmemizi istiyor. Sonunda ışığa ulaşma şansımız geldi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#603.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#604.src: And I know how we do that!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#604.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.src: You must have realized by now that he is a direct contact to the other side. I think... I think it's time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.dst: Onun öbür tarafla doğrudan bağlantı olduğunu artık anlamışsınızdır. Sanırım... sanırım vakit geldi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.src: ...cutting down the Guardian of the Forest!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.src: Believe me- I hear how ludicrous this all sounds.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.dst: İnanın bana- bunun ne kadar saçma geldiğinin farkındayım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.src: But think, why would I have visions of witnessing him moments after visions of the Guardian?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.dst: Ama düşünün, Muhafız'ı gördüğüm görülerin hemen ardından neden onu gördüğüm görüler göreyim?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.src: We would be the first of our kind to witness him before death!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.dst: Ölmeden önce onu gören ilk elfler biz olacağız!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.src: I believe that's what he wants!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.src: Today is the day we meet our God!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#616.src: We will take down the Guardian of the Forest to open a gateway!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#616.dst: Bir geçit açmak için Orman Muhafızı'nı devireceğiz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#616.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.src: Today we establish history and a new chapter for all elves!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.dst: Bugün tarih yazıyor ve bütün elfler için yeni bir sayfa açıyoruz!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#620.src: We do not have the time. Move along, young one.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#620.dst: Hiç vaktimiz yok. Yoluna devam et, genç.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#620.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.src: Wait! I don't think... this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.dst: Durun! Bence bu... iyi bir fikir değil.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.src: But... I really don't think you should go ahead and hurt the Gua-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.dst: Ama... bence gerçekten gidip Muhafız'a zarar vermemeli-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.src: As the Elders of this town we've already decided on this. You are welcome to join us for this moment, young elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.dst: Bu kasabanın İhtiyarları olarak buna çoktan karar verdik. Bu ana bizimle katılabilirsin, genç elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.src: But if you as much as try to stop us, you will be banished.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.dst: Ama bizi durdurmaya kalkışırsan bile sürgün edilirsin.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#632.src: Talk to the Elders about the vision.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#634.src: This secret can never leave {p}. If it does- people will riot and wars will break out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#634.dst: Bu sır asla {p} dışına çıkamaz. Çıkarsa halk isyan eder, savaşlar patlak verir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#634.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.src: Elves who had nothing to do with their decision will die.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.dst: O kararla hiçbir ilgisi olmayan elfler ölür.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#636.src: This is far greater than any of us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#636.dst: Bu, hepimizden çok daha büyük bir mesele.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#636.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#637.src: I understand you may have questions.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#637.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#638.src: Elder Prometheus died of old age, almost everyone from that time is dead. He elected us six to keep the secret safe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#638.dst: İhtiyar Prometheus yaşlılıktan öldü, o zamandan neredeyse herkes öldü. Sırrı korumak için biz altımızı seçti.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#638.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#639.src: Apparently the immortality hadn't set in just yet- magic takes time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#639.dst: Görünüşe göre ölümsüzlük henüz etkisini göstermemişti- büyü zaman alır.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#639.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#640.src: I don't think he really understood the extent of what he had done. We slowly began connecting the dots.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#640.dst: Yaptığı şeyin boyutunu gerçekten anladığını sanmıyorum. Biz yavaş yavaş taşları yerine oturtmaya başladık.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#640.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#641.src: Everything seemed to lead back to the portals opening- the war in Wynn and the attack on Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#641.dst: Her şey geçitlerin açılmasına çıkıyordu- Wynn'deki savaşa ve Gavel'e yapılan saldırıya.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#641.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#642.src: The magical wood from the Guardian of the Forest must radiate magic that grants us our life.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#642.dst: Orman Muhafızı'nın büyülü ahşabı bize hayat veren bir büyü yayıyor olmalı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#642.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#643.src: This is why we locked up {p}, letting people live immortal lives would have dire consequences.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#643.dst: {p} şehrini bu yüzden dışarıya kapattık, insanların ölümsüz yaşamasına izin vermenin korkunç sonuçları olurdu.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#643.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#644.src: We tried to at least make up for some of the damage we had done...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#644.dst: Verdiğimiz zararın en azından bir kısmını telafi etmeye çalıştık...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#644.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#645.src: The portal being opened here caused a chain reaction that opened every portal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#645.dst: Burada açılan geçit, bütün geçitleri açan bir zincirleme tepkiye yol açtı.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#645.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#646.src: This is unfortunately what cursed the world and made it possible for the corruption to leak into Wynn and beings of darkness to breach Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#646.dst: Ne yazık ki dünyayı lanetleyen, yozlaşmanın Wynn'e sızmasını ve karanlık varlıkların Gavel'e girmesini mümkün kılan buydu.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#646.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#647.src: This used to be an open cave that we decided to hide the rest of the Guardian in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#647.dst: Burası eskiden açık bir mağaraydı, Muhafız'ın geri kalanını buraya saklamaya karar verdik.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#647.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#648.src: It seems like the immense magic transformed this place to look like this...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#648.dst: Görünüşe göre muazzam büyü burayı bu hâle dönüştürmüş...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#648.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#650.src: We can't put innocent lives at risk- don't you agree?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#650.dst: Masum hayatları tehlikeye atamayız- sizce de öyle değil mi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#650.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#652.src: We will make our leave, you can jump after us to return to {p} Town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#652.dst: Biz ayrılıyoruz, {p} kasabasına dönmek için arkamızdan atlayabilirsiniz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#652.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#655.src: I didn't even hear you come in. I was too sucked up in this interesting book "Live Life Love Life".
Aldorei's Secret Part II#655.dst: Geldiğini duymadım bile. "Hayatı Yaşa Hayatı Sev" adlı bu ilginç kitaba fazla dalmışım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#655.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#657.src: I've been reading all day to get myself in a different head space.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#657.dst: Kafamı başka yere vermek için bütün gün kitap okuyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#657.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#658.src: Ah, who am I kidding- this book SUCKS!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#658.dst: Ah, kimi kandırıyorum- bu kitap BERBAT!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#658.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#659.src: Come back tomorrow, please. I have about five more books to get through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#659.dst: Lütfen yarın gel. Bitirmem gereken beş kitap daha var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#659.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#661.src: I got inspired from my journey through the world of motivational writing yesterday.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#661.dst: Dün motivasyon kitaplarının dünyasında yaptığım yolculuktan ilham aldım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#661.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#662.src: The best thing in the world is to help people around you, is that not right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#662.dst: Dünyadaki en güzel şey etrafındaki insanlara yardım etmek, değil mi ama.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#662.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#663.src: This way I'll keep myself busy while still being of assistance.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#663.dst: Böylece hem kendimi meşgul ederim hem de işe yararım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#663.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#664.src: Well, I'm doing better. Thank you for asking.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#664.dst: Eh, daha iyiyim. Sorduğun için teşekkürler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#664.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#665.src: My shame is slowly turning into hatred for those old elders, maybe that's progress.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#665.dst: Utancım yavaş yavaş o yaşlı ihtiyarlara karşı nefrete dönüşüyor, belki bu da bir ilerlemedir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#665.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#666.src: Please come back tomorrow, I have a gift for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#666.dst: Lütfen yarın tekrar gel, sana bir hediyem var.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#666.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#668.src: I know I couldn't have done anything, I just find it so stupid.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#668.dst: Hiçbir şey yapamayacağımı biliyorum, sadece çok aptalca buluyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#668.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#669.src: Stupid that the so called, "all mighty, selfless elves" did something like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#669.dst: Sözde "her şeye kadir, fedakâr elflerin" böyle bir şey yapması aptalca.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#669.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#672.src: You are earlier than I expected.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#672.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#673.src: I was planning to cook you a nice meal to as a thank you for getting me through these past two days and for helping me earlier.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#673.dst: Bu son iki günü atlatmama ve daha önce yardım ettiğin için teşekkür olarak sana güzel bir yemek pişirmeyi planlıyordum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#673.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#674.src: I decided to pick up a couple of new hobbies to get my mind working, cooking being one of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#674.dst: Kafamı çalıştırmak için birkaç yeni hobi edinmeye karar verdim, yemek yapmak da bunlardan biri.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#674.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#675.src: You have truly done more than I ever could have imagined. I'm proud to call you my friend.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#675.dst: Hayal edebileceğimden çok daha fazlasını yaptın. Sana arkadaşım demekten gurur duyuyorum.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#675.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#677.src: I may or may not have forgot a couple of ingredients for my stew!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#677.dst: Güveç için birkaç malzemeyi unutmuş olabilirim de, olmayabilirim de!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#677.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#678.src: Can you go around the forest seeing if you can find [{~} Leafy Stalks] and [{~} Mycanoid Spores] please.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#678.dst: Lütfen ormanda dolaşıp [{~} Leafy Stalks] ve [{~} Mycanoid Spores] bulabilir misin bir bak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#678.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#680.src: I think I'm finally getting over my guilt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#680.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#681.src: I realized that I never really took time to grieve my parents' death and I guess I was so occupied finding an answer to my big conspiracy that {p} killed them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#681.dst: Annemle babamın ölümünün yasını tutmaya hiç vakit ayırmadığımı fark ettim, galiba {p} onları öldürdü diye kurduğum büyük komploya cevap bulmakla fazla meşguldüm.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#681.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#682.src: Then finding out all that information... It just all came crashing down on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#682.dst: Sonra bütün o bilgileri öğrenince... Hepsi birden üstüme çöktü.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#682.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#683.src: I'm grateful that you've managed to pull me out of that dark space, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#683.dst: Beni o karanlık yerden çekip çıkardığın için minnettarım, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#683.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#686.src: I stayed up all night working on this new project of mine.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#686.dst: Bütün gece uyumadım, bu yeni projem üzerinde çalıştım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#686.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#687.src: I picked up the wonderful art of painting and decided to make something for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#687.dst: O harika resim sanatına merak sardım ve sana bir şey yapmaya karar verdim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#687.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#688.src: I've also gone the entire day feeling good, for once.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#688.dst: Ayrıca ilk defa bütün günü iyi hissederek geçirdim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#688.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#689.src: I feel like I'm back on track. So it's time for me to start stressing over another conspiracy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#689.dst: Yeniden yoluma girmiş gibi hissediyorum. Demek ki başka bir komplo için kafa yormaya başlama vakti.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#689.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#690.src: I'm actually on my way to the {p} library to do some light reading, hoping to stumble upon another mystery.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#690.dst: Aslında biraz hafif okuma yapmak için {p} kütüphanesine gidiyorum, umarım yeni bir gizeme rastlarım.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#690.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#692.src: I hope you are careful on wherever journey leads you. If you ever need me, just drop by.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#692.dst: Yolun seni nereye götürürse götürsün umarım dikkatli olursun. Bana ihtiyacın olursa uğraman yeter.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#692.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#693.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the Valley.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#694.src: Perfect! {u}, let's take that elevator upstairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#694.dst: Harika! {u}, hemen o asansörle yukarı çıkalım.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#695.src: Wait! I don't think.. this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#695.dst: Durun! Bence bu.. iyi bir fikir değil.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#696.src: You can come back to Mona later.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#698.src: Uhm. Actually I'm busy, I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#698.dst: Ii. Aslında meşgulüm, bugün yapacak çok işim var.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#699.src: Perhaps Mona didn't like your attitude.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#701.src: Farewell, make sure to let everybody know that I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#701.dst: Elveda, herkese en akıllının ben olduğumu söylemeyi unutma!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#702.src: In that case- I assume majority of elves were buried in the lesser ones.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#702.dst: O zaman- sanırım elflerin çoğu daha sade olanlara gömüldü.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#704.src: The documents should be in here somewhere.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#705.src: You flip through various documents before you find something that seems of interest...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#705.dst: İlginç görünen bir şey bulana dek çeşitli belgeleri karıştırıyorsun...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#706.src: - {~}:{~} {p} Elves returned with freshly picked flowers. Canyon is stable.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#706.dst: - {~}:{~} {p} elfleri taze toplanmış çiçeklerle döndü. Kanyon stabil.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#707.src: - {~}:{~} Small piece of rubble fell near {p} Wall. Nothing to be concerned of.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#707.dst: - {~}:{~} {p} Duvarı yakınına küçük bir moloz parçası düştü. Endişe edecek bir şey yok.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#708.src: - {~}:{~} Mysterious group of elves spotted heading into the canyon through the eastern exit.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#708.dst: - {~}:{~} Gizemli bir elf grubunun doğu çıkışından kanyona girdiği görüldü.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#709.src: - {~}:{~} Spotted elves again. Seems like... the six elders?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#709.dst: - {~}:{~} Elfler yine görüldü. Galiba... altı ihtiyar?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#710.src: - {~}:{~} They just entered one cave system we previously deemed as a dangerous area.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#710.dst: - {~}:{~} Daha önce tehlikeli bölge saydığımız bir mağara sistemine girdiler.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#711.src: - {~}:{~} Only five elders returned. They left one behind. I will mark the spot with an orange flag for further investigation.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#711.dst: - {~}:{~} Sadece beş ihtiyar döndü. Birini geride bıraktılar. Daha sonra incelemek için yeri turuncu bir bayrakla işaretleyeceğim.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#712.src: Olon talked about the eastern exit next to the bank.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#712.dst: Olon bankanın yanındaki doğu çıkışından bahsetmişti.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#713.src: Venture into the canyon of the lost and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#713.dst: Kayıplar kanyonuna gir ve [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda mühürlenmiş İhtiyar'ın girişini bul

Aldorei's Secret Part II#714.src: A sound can be heard from the main path...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#715.src: You've already interacted with this crystal.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#717.src: Birch did not like that answer. You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#717.dst: Birch bu cevabı beğenmedi. Tekrar denemen gerek!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#718.src: You seem to be getting nowhere. You might need to trace back!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#718.dst: Hiçbir yere varamıyorsun gibi. Geri dönmen gerekebilir!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#720.src: The Elders ignored the young elf's worries and went ahead.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#720.dst: İhtiyarlar genç elfin endişelerini duymazdan gelip devam etti.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#721.src: The thought of reaching their god was stronger than any logic.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#721.dst: Tanrılarına ulaşma düşüncesi her türlü mantıktan güçlüydü.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#722.src: The portal revealed itself, but no one could approach its center.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#722.dst: Geçit ortaya çıktı ama kimse merkezine yaklaşamadı.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#723.src: The elves were successful, but none of them could grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#723.dst: Elfler başarılı oldu ama hiçbiri ışığa ulaşamadı.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#724.src: Little did they realize, that this was the start of the end. The act that set off everything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#724.dst: Bunun sonun başlangıcı olduğunun farkında değillerdi. Her şeyi başlatan eylem buydu.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#725.src: The opening of the Light Portal caused a chain reaction throughout the world.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#725.dst: Işık Geçidi'nin açılması dünya çapında bir zincirleme tepkiye yol açtı.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#726.src: The Realm of War Portal opened in Wynn.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#727.src: The Realm of Darkness Portal was also opened.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#728.src: The portals that had lied dormant for so many years... this was the beginning of a new era.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#728.dst: Onca yıldır uykuda olan geçitler... bu yeni bir çağın başlangıcıydı.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#729.src: An era of an endless war- all created because of a selfish wish.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#729.dst: Sonu gelmeyen bir savaş çağı- hepsi bencil bir dilek yüzünden.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#730.src: You make your way back to {p}...
